theme: minerals safeguarding waste planning plan data and restoration

sources.title: Minerals
sources.facts: Covers safeguarding, extraction, impacts, restoration, aggregate supply, industrial minerals and review of conditions.
sources.guard: Guidance does not prove a mineral resource, viable extraction, safeguarding conflict or planning permission at a site.

sources.title: National Planning Policy Framework - Facilitating the sustainable use of minerals
sources.facts: Sets policy for mineral supply, conservation, recycled materials, safeguarding and development decisions.
sources.guard: National policy does not identify exact mineral quality, quantity, ownership, viability or consent.

sources.title: National planning policy for waste
sources.facts: Sets detailed policies on sustainable waste infrastructure, the waste hierarchy, proximity, health and environmental protection.
sources.guard: Policy does not prove a waste facility is needed, acceptable, permitted, financed or deliverable.

sources.title: Waste
sources.facts: Explains site suitability, health and environmental safeguards, local plans, decisions, enforcement and the waste hierarchy.
sources.guard: Guidance does not prove site suitability, permit status, capacity or environmental compliance.

sources.title: Create or update a local plan using the new system
sources.facts: Covers local, minerals and waste plans under the amended statutory plan-making framework.
sources.guard: A guidance collection does not prove a minerals or waste plan is adopted, sound, current or site-allocating.

sources.title: Publish your plan data
sources.facts: Updated 13 May 2026; requires approved data standards for local-plan and minerals/waste-plan timetables.
sources.guard: Published timetable data does not prove adoption, policy effect, allocation or delivery.

sources.title: Plan-making regulations explainer
sources.facts: Explains new statutory stages and the requirement for minerals and waste planning authorities to prepare plans.
sources.guard: Process rules do not prove a plan completed examination or took legal effect.

sources.title: Guide to reclaiming mineral extraction and landfill sites to agriculture
sources.facts: Covers consultation, soil handling, restoration and aftercare expectations for mineral and landfill sites returned to agriculture.
sources.guard: Restoration guidance does not prove soil condition, restoration success, aftercare completion or agricultural quality.

package_guard: Minerals and waste policy, safeguarding guidance, plan-making standards and restoration advice do not by themselves prove exact-site resources, sterilisation, allocation, need, capacity, permit, consent, environmental acceptability, restoration success, funding, commercial viability or delivery.
